profile.campus_sqft_context: DataBank’s third data center on the Granite Point Campus, SLC4 leverages a private power substation to provide HPC-capable, high-density colocation cabinets ideal for compute-intensive workloads. The campus boasts outstanding connectivity with access to many carriers and cloud providers. 20,740 IT Square Feet

reading.body:
DataBank SLC4 publishes 3.67 MW of IT capacity across 20,740 square feet, making it the smallest of the three buildings on the Granite Point Campus in Bluffdale. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 3.67 MW of IT load is roughly 92 racks, meaning this is a boutique facility rather than a hyperscale one. The operator's own description notes a private power substation and positions the site for high-density, compute-intensive workloads, which is the configuration AI inference and HPC jobs require, but the published figure caps what any tenant could actually deploy.

Among the 8 Utah facilities for which this site has read a published megawatt figure, SLC4 ranks fourth out of 51.69 MW total, contributing about 7 percent of that published pool. Twenty-one facilities are mapped in the state overall, and most publish no capacity figure, so the true Utah inventory is larger than what these numbers capture. SLC4's rank therefore reflects its position only within the disclosed subset.

No certifications are listed in the published specifications for this facility, so no claim can be made here about what compliance posture it meets. Connectivity is described in operator prose as broad, but carrier names and cloud on-ramps are not published in the structured data this reading draws from. For an AI buyer, the site's honest importance is narrow: a small, high-density colocation option inside an existing campus that already has dedicated substation infrastructure, suited to a tenant needing dense compute in a mid-tier market rather than raw scale.
